name: rea-web
description: REA Web + Build Recovery: downstream web control plane, runners and recovery tooling for upstream REA.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.json --noEmit false && npm run typecheck -w @rea-web/web
scripts.lint: cd .. && npx oxlint rea-web && npx oxfmt --check rea-web
scripts.deploy:validate: npm run deploy:typecheck && tsx tools/deploy/validate-railway.ts && REA_WEB_RUNNER_TOKEN=placeholder docker compose -f deploy/compose/compose.yaml --profile runner config --quiet
